170				slog.Bool("has_shadow_branch", hasShadowBranch),
171				slog.String("transcript_path", state.TranscriptPath),
172			)
173			return newSkippedResult(checkpointID, state.SessionID), nil
174		}
175	
176		filterFilesTouched(sessionData, committedFiles, state)
177	
178		redactedTranscript, redactDuration := redactOrDrop(logCtx, sessionData.Transcript, state.SessionID, checkpointID)
179		if skipped := skipIfPostRedactionEmpty(logCtx, redactedTranscript, sessionData, state, checkpointID); skipped != nil {
180			return skipped, nil
181		}
182	
183		// Get checkpoint store
184		store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
185		if err != nil {
186			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
187		}
188	
189		// Get author info
190		authorName, authorEmail := GetGitAuthorFromRepo(repo)
191	
192		// Determine attribution base commit
193		attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit
194		if attrBase == "" {
195			attrBase = state.BaseCommit
196		}
197	
198		attributionStart := time.Now()
199		attrCtx, attributionSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "calculate_session_attribution")
200		attribution := calculateSessionAttributions(attrCtx, repo, ref, sessionData, state, attributionOpts{
201			headTree:              o.headTree,
202			parentTree:            o.parentTree,
203			repoDir:               o.repoDir,
204			attributionBaseCommit: attrBase,
205			parentCommitHash:      o.parentCommitHash,
206			headCommitHash:        o.headCommitHash,
207			allAgentFiles:         o.allAgentFiles,
208		})
209		attributionSpan.End()
210		attributionDuration := time.Since(attributionStart)
211	
212		// Get current branch name
213		branchName := GetCurrentBranchName(repo)
214	
215		var summary *cpkg.Summary
216		if settings.IsSummarizeEnabled(ctx) && redactedTranscript.Len() > 0 {
217			summary = generateSummary(ctx, redactedTranscript, sessionData.FilesTouched, state)
218		}
219	
220		// Build write options (shared by v1 and v2)
221		writeOpts := cpkg.WriteCommittedOptions{
222			CheckpointID:                checkpointID,
223			SessionID:                   state.SessionID,
224			Strategy:                    StrategyNameManualCommit,
225			Branch:                      branchName,
226			Transcript:                  redactedTranscript,
227			Prompts:                     sessionData.Prompts,
228			FilesTouched:                sessionData.FilesTouched,
229			CheckpointsCount:            state.StepCount,
230			EphemeralBranch:             shadowBranchName,
231			AuthorName:                  authorName,
232			AuthorEmail:                 authorEmail,
233			Agent:                       state.AgentType,
234			Model:                       state.ModelName,
235			TurnID:                      state.TurnID,
236			TranscriptIdentifierAtStart: state.TranscriptIdentifierAtStart,
237			CheckpointTranscriptStart:   state.CheckpointTranscriptStart,
238			TokenUsage:                  sessionData.TokenUsage,
239			SessionMetrics:              buildSessionMetrics(state),
240			InitialAttribution:          attribution,
241			PromptAttributionsJSON:      marshalPromptAttributionsIncludingPending(state),
242			Summary:                     summary,
243		}
244	
245		compactResult := buildExternalCompactTranscript(ctx, ag, state)
246		if compactResult == nil {
247			internalResult := buildInternalCompactTranscript(ctx, ag, redactedTranscript, state)
248			compactResult = &internalResult
249		}
250		writeOpts.CompactTranscript = compactResult.Transcript
251		writeOpts.CompactTranscriptStart = compactResult.StartLine
252	
253		v2 := settings.CheckpointsVersion(ctx) == 2
254	
255		// Write checkpoint metadata to the primary store.
256		writeV1Start := time.Now()
257		writeCtx, writeCommittedSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "write_committed_v1")
258		if !v2 {
259			if err := store.WriteCommitted(writeCtx, writeOpts); err != nil {
260				writeCommittedSpan.RecordError(err)
261				writeCommittedSpan.End()
262				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write checkpoint metadata: %w", err)
263			}
264		}
265		writeCommittedSpan.End()
266		writeV1Duration := time.Since(writeV1Start)
267	
268		writeV2Start := time.Now()
269		writeV2Ctx, writeCommittedV2Span := perf.Start(ctx, "write_committed_v2")
270		if v2 {
271			if err := writeCommittedV2(writeV2Ctx, repo, writeOpts); err != nil {
272				writeCommittedV2Span.RecordError(err)
273				writeCommittedV2Span.End()
274				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write checkpoint metadata to v2: %w", err)
275			}
276		} else {
277			writeCommittedV2IfEnabled(writeV2Ctx, repo, writeOpts)
278		}
279		writeTaskMetadataV2IfEnabled(writeV2Ctx, repo, checkpointID, state.SessionID, ref)
280		writeCommittedV2Span.End()
281		writeV2Duration := time.Since(writeV2Start)
282	
283		logging.Debug(logCtx, "condense timings",
284			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
285			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
286			slog.Int64("extract_session_data_ms", extractDuration.Milliseconds()),
287			slog.Int64("calculate_session_attribution_ms", attributionDuration.Milliseconds()),
288			slog.Int64("redact_transcript_ms", redactDuration.Milliseconds()),
289			slog.Int64("compact_transcript_v2_ms", compactResult.Duration.Milliseconds()),
290			slog.Int64("write_committed_v1_ms", writeV1Duration.Milliseconds()),
291			slog.Int64("write_committed_v2_ms", writeV2Duration.Milliseconds()),
292			slog.Int64("total_ms", time.Since(condenseStart).Milliseconds()),
293			slog.Int("transcript_bytes", len(sessionData.Transcript)),
294			slog.Int("transcript_lines", sessionData.FullTranscriptLines),
295		)
296	
297		// Count scoped (new-only) compact lines, not full compact lines,
298		// so state.CompactTranscriptStart accumulates correctly.
299		compactLines := 0
300		if compactResult.Transcript != nil {
301			fullLines := countCompactLines(compactResult.Transcript)
302			compactLines = fullLines - compactResult.StartLine
303		}
304	
305		return &CondenseResult{
306			CheckpointID:           checkpointID,
307			SessionID:              state.SessionID,
308			CheckpointsCount:       state.StepCount,
309			FilesTouched:           sessionData.FilesTouched,
310			Prompts:                sessionData.Prompts,
311			TotalTranscriptLines:   sessionData.FullTranscriptLines,
312			CompactTranscriptLines: compactLines,
313			Transcript:             sessionData.Transcript,
314		}, nil
315	}

317	// redactOrDrop runs redactSessionTranscript and, on failure, logs a warning
318	// and returns empty bytes. Drop-on-failure is the long-standing contract here:
319	// hooks have no retry path, and a failed redaction must not block the commit.
320	func redactOrDrop(logCtx context.Context, transcript []byte, sessionID string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) (redact.RedactedBytes, time.Duration) {
321		redactedTranscript, redactDuration, err := redactSessionTranscript(logCtx, transcript)
322		if err != nil {
323			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to redact transcript secrets, dropping transcript for checkpoint",
324				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
325				slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
326				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
327			)
328			return redact.RedactedBytes{}, redactDuration
329		}
330		return redactedTranscript, redactDuration
331	}

339			return nil

342			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
343			slog.String("agent_type", string(state.AgentType)),
344			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
345		)

347	}

357	// redactSessionTranscript redacts the transcript once for use by both the compact
358	// package and the checkpoint stores. Returns the redacted bytes and the duration
359	// of the redaction operation for perf logging.
360	func redactSessionTranscript(ctx context.Context, transcript []byte) (redact.RedactedBytes, time.Duration, error) {
361		start := time.Now()
362		_, span := perf.Start(ctx, "redact_transcript")
363		defer span.End()
364	
365		if len(transcript) == 0 {
366			return redact.RedactedBytes{}, time.Since(start), nil
367		}
368	
369		redacted, err := redactSessionJSONLBytes(transcript)
370		if err != nil {
371			span.RecordError(err)
372			return redact.RedactedBytes{}, time.Since(start), fmt.Errorf("failed to redact transcript secrets: %w", err)
373		}
374		return redacted, time.Since(start), nil
375	}

391	// filterFilesTouched narrows sessionData.FilesTouched to files present in
392	// committedFiles. When no prior files were recorded, it falls back to the
393	// committed set (minus Entire metadata) — but only when sessionHasEvidenceOfWork
394	// is true. The fallback was originally unconditional, which let sessions that
395	// were registered at SessionStart but never produced anything (e.g. ephemeral
396	// Codex sessions whose hooks fired with a null transcript_path and never
397	// reached SaveStep) inherit another session's committed files.
398	func filterFilesTouched(sessionData *ExtractedSessionData, committedFiles map[string]struct{}, state *SessionState) {
399		if len(committedFiles) == 0 {
400			return
401		}
402		if len(sessionData.FilesTouched) > 0 {
403			filtered := make([]string, 0, len(sessionData.FilesTouched))
404			for _, f := range sessionData.FilesTouched {
405				if _, ok := committedFiles[f]; ok {
406					filtered = append(filtered, f)
407				}
408			}
409			sessionData.FilesTouched = filtered
410			return
411		}
412		if !sessionHasEvidenceOfWork(sessionData, state) {
413			return
414		}
415		sessionData.FilesTouched = committedFilesExcludingMetadata(committedFiles)
416	}
417	
418	// sessionHasEvidenceOfWork returns true when the session looks like a real
419	// participant — either it produced a readable transcript or a prior SaveStep
420	// recorded a checkpoint (StepCount > 0). False means the session was likely
421	// registered but never did anything; treating such a session as the author of
422	// the committed files would attribute another session's work to it.
423	func sessionHasEvidenceOfWork(sessionData *ExtractedSessionData, state *SessionState) bool {
424		if len(sessionData.Transcript) > 0 {
425			return true
426		}
427		return state != nil && state.StepCount > 0
428	}

430	// extractOrCreateSessionData tries to extract session data from the shadow branch,
431	// live transcript, or creates empty session data as a fallback. The empty case is
432	// handled by the skip gate in CondenseSession.
433	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractOrCreateSessionData(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, ag agent.Agent, shadowHash plumbing.Hash, hasShadowBranch bool, state *SessionState) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
434		switch {
435		case hasShadowBranch:
436			// Shadow branch exists (from SaveStep commits) — extract transcript and
437			// metadata from the branch tree, preferring the live transcript if fresher.
438			data, err := s.extractSessionData(ctx, repo, shadowHash, state.SessionID, state.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, state.Phase.IsActive())
439			if err != nil {
440				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data: %w", err)
441			}
442			return data, nil
443		case state.TranscriptPath != "":
444			// No shadow branch but a live transcript path is known — read directly
445			// from disk. This handles mid-session commits before SaveStep runs.
446			if state.Phase.IsActive() {
447				prepareTranscriptIfNeeded(ctx, ag, state.TranscriptPath)
448			}
449			data, err := s.extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript(ctx, state)
450			if err != nil {
451				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data from live transcript: %w", err)
452			}
453			return data, nil
454		default:
455			// No shadow branch and no transcript path — create empty session data.
456			// This happens for sessions where the agent never set TranscriptPath
457			// (e.g., Codex hooks may send null transcript_path). The skip gate in
458			// CondenseSession will skip condensation if nothing is found.
459			logging.Debug(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint"),
460				"no shadow branch and no transcript path, returning empty session data",
461				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
462				slog.String("agent_type", string(state.AgentType)),
463			)
464			return &ExtractedSessionData{
465				FilesTouched: state.FilesTouched,
466			}, nil
467		}
468	}

477	// compactAndRedactExternalTranscript calls the external agent's compact-transcript
478	// subcommand and redacts the result. Returns (nil, false) if the agent is not
479	// external. Returns (nil, true) if the agent is external but compaction failed.
480	func compactAndRedactExternalTranscript(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, state *SessionState) (transcript []byte, isExternal bool) {
481		compactor, ok := agent.AsTranscriptCompactor(ag)
482		if !ok {
483			if _, isCap := ag.(agent.CapabilityDeclarer); isCap {
484				logging.Warn(ctx, "external transcript compaction unavailable, skipping transcript.jsonl",
485					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
486					slog.String("agent", string(ag.Name())),
487				)
488				return nil, true
489			}
490			return nil, false
491		}
492	
493		compacted := compactTranscriptForExternalAgent(ctx, compactor, state.SessionID, state.TranscriptPath)
494		if compacted == nil {
495			return nil, true
496		}
497	
498		redacted, err := redactSessionJSONLBytes(compacted.Transcript)
499		if err != nil {
500			logging.Warn(ctx, "failed to redact external compact transcript, dropping",
501				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
502				slog.String("agent", string(compactor.Name())),
503				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
504			)
505			return nil, true
506		}
507		return redacted.Bytes(), true
508	}

510	// buildExternalCompactTranscript produces the compact transcript for external
511	// agents by calling the agent's compact-transcript subcommand and redacting
512	// the result. Returns nil if the agent is not external (caller should use
513	// buildInternalCompactTranscript instead).
514	func buildExternalCompactTranscript(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, state *SessionState) *compactTranscriptResult {
515		if !settings.IsCheckpointsV2Enabled(ctx) {
516			return nil
517		}
518	
519		compactStart := time.Now()
520		compactCtx, compactSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "compact_transcript_v2")
521		defer compactSpan.End()
522	
523		transcript, isExternal := compactAndRedactExternalTranscript(compactCtx, ag, state)
524		if !isExternal {
525			return nil
526		}
527		if transcript == nil {
528			return &compactTranscriptResult{Duration: time.Since(compactStart)}
529		}
530	
531		startLine := state.CompactTranscriptStart
532		fullLines := countCompactLines(transcript)
533		if fullLines < startLine {
534			logging.Warn(compactCtx, "external compact transcript shorter than previous compact transcript start; resetting compact transcript start",
535				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
536				slog.String("agent", string(ag.Name())),
537				slog.Int("compact_transcript_lines", fullLines),
538				slog.Int("previous_compact_transcript_start", startLine),
539			)
540			startLine = 0
541		}
542	
543		return &compactTranscriptResult{
544			Transcript: transcript,
545			StartLine:  startLine,
546			Duration:   time.Since(compactStart),
547		}
548	}

550	// buildInternalCompactTranscript produces the compact transcript for built-in
551	// agents from already-redacted transcript bytes.
552	func buildInternalCompactTranscript(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, redacted redact.RedactedBytes, state *SessionState) compactTranscriptResult {
553		if !settings.IsCheckpointsV2Enabled(ctx) {
554			return compactTranscriptResult{}
555		}
556	
557		compactStart := time.Now()
558		compactCtx, compactSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "compact_transcript_v2")
559		defer compactSpan.End()
560	
561		// Generate scoped compact (only new content) for line counting and offset calculation.
562		scopedCompact := compactTranscriptForV2(compactCtx, ag, redacted, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
563		// Generate full compact (cumulative) for storage — v2 /main replaces
564		// the session's transcript.jsonl on each write, so we must include all
565		// prior content, not just the new portion.
566		fullCompact := compactTranscriptForV2(compactCtx, ag, redacted, 0)
567		startLine := computeCompactTranscriptStart(compactCtx, ag, state, redacted.Bytes(), scopedCompact)
568	
569		return compactTranscriptResult{
570			Transcript: fullCompact,
571			StartLine:  startLine,
572			Duration:   time.Since(compactStart),
573		}
574	}

576	func compactTranscriptForExternalAgent(
577		ctx context.Context,
578		compactor agent.TranscriptCompactor,
579		sessionID string,
580		transcriptPath string,
581	) *agent.CompactedTranscript {
582		if transcriptPath == "" {
583			logging.Warn(ctx, "external transcript compaction skipped: missing session transcript path",
584				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
585				slog.String("agent", string(compactor.Name())),
586			)
587			return nil
588		}

590		compacted, err := compactor.CompactTranscript(ctx, transcriptPath)
591		if err != nil {
592			logging.Warn(ctx, "external transcript compaction failed, skipping transcript.jsonl on /main",
593				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
594				slog.String("agent", string(compactor.Name())),
595				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
596			)
597			return nil
598		}
599		if compacted == nil {
600			logging.Warn(ctx, "external transcript compaction returned nil transcript",
601				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
602				slog.String("agent", string(compactor.Name())),
603			)
604			return nil
605		}
606		if len(bytes.TrimSpace(compacted.Transcript)) == 0 {
607			logging.Warn(ctx, "external transcript compaction returned empty transcript",
608				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
609				slog.String("agent", string(compactor.Name())),
610			)
611			return nil
612		}
613		if !bytes.HasSuffix(compacted.Transcript, []byte{'\n'}) {
614			compacted.Transcript = append(compacted.Transcript, '\n')
615		}
616		if len(compacted.Assets) > 0 {
617			logging.Warn(ctx, "external transcript compaction returned assets that are not yet persisted",
618				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
619				slog.String("agent", string(compactor.Name())),
620				slog.Int("asset_count", len(compacted.Assets)),
621			)
622		}
623		return compacted
624	}

626	// generateSummary produces an LLM-generated summary of the session transcript.
627	// The transcript must be pre-redacted to avoid sending secrets to the LLM.
628	// Returns nil if the scoped transcript is empty or generation fails.
629	func generateSummary(ctx context.Context, redactedTranscript redact.RedactedBytes, filesTouched []string, state *SessionState) *cpkg.Summary {
630		summarizeCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "summarize")
631		transcriptBytes := redactedTranscript.Bytes()
632	
633		var scopedTranscript []byte
634		switch state.AgentType {
635		case agent.AgentTypeGemini:
636			scoped, sliceErr := geminicli.SliceFromMessage(transcriptBytes, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
637			if sliceErr != nil {
638				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "failed to scope Gemini transcript for summary",
639					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
640					slog.String("error", sliceErr.Error()))
641			}
642			scopedTranscript = scoped
643		case agent.AgentTypeOpenCode:
644			scoped, sliceErr := opencode.SliceFromMessage(transcriptBytes, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
645			if sliceErr != nil {
646				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "failed to scope OpenCode transcript for summary",
647					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
648					slog.String("error", sliceErr.Error()))
649			}
650			scopedTranscript = scoped
651		case agent.AgentTypeCodex, agent.AgentTypeClaudeCode, agent.AgentTypeCursor, agent.AgentTypeFactoryAIDroid, agent.AgentTypeUnknown:
652			scopedTranscript = transcript.SliceFromLine(transcriptBytes, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
653		}
654	
655		if len(scopedTranscript) == 0 {
656			return nil
657		}
658	
659		generator := buildSummaryGenerator(summarizeCtx)
660		// scopedTranscript is sliced from redactedTranscript, which was redacted earlier in CondenseSession.
661		summary, err := summarize.GenerateFromTranscript(summarizeCtx, redact.AlreadyRedacted(scopedTranscript), filesTouched, state.AgentType, generator)
662		if err != nil {
663			logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "summary generation failed",
664				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
665				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
666			return nil
667		}
668		logging.Info(summarizeCtx, "summary generated",
669			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID))
670		return summary
671	}

673	// buildSummaryGenerator returns a Generator based on the configured summary provider.
674	// Returns nil if no provider is configured (GenerateFromTranscript falls back to ClaudeGenerator).
675	//
676	// The return type is the summarize.Generator interface rather than the concrete
677	// adapter pointer so callers can't accidentally hold a non-nil interface that
678	// wraps a nil pointer (the classic Go nil-interface footgun).
679	func buildSummaryGenerator(ctx context.Context) summarize.Generator { //nolint:ireturn // interface return for nil-safety
680		s, err := settings.Load(ctx)
681		if err != nil {
682			// Warn (not Debug): this is the auto-summarize hot path on every commit.
683			// A settings-load failure silently downgrades the user's configured
684			// provider to the default, and Debug would hide that from operators.
685			logging.Warn(ctx, "could not load settings for summary provider, using default",
686				"error", err.Error())
687			return nil
688		}
689		if s.SummaryGeneration == nil || s.SummaryGeneration.Provider == "" {
690			return nil
691		}
692	
693		providerName := types.AgentName(s.SummaryGeneration.Provider)
694		ag, err := agent.Get(providerName)
695		if err != nil {
696			logging.Warn(ctx, "configured summary provider not available, using default",
697				"provider", s.SummaryGeneration.Provider, "error", err.Error())
698			return nil
699		}
700	
701		// Check binary on PATH, not DetectPresence — a repo can use one agent
702		// for development while a different agent generates summaries. Fall back
703		// silently (Warn log) because this runs in the post-commit hook and a
704		// hard error would block the commit.
705		if !agent.IsSummaryCLIAvailable(providerName) {
706			logging.Warn(ctx, "configured summary provider CLI binary not on PATH, using default",
707				"provider", s.SummaryGeneration.Provider)
708			return nil
709		}
710	
711		tg, ok := agent.AsTextGenerator(ag)
712		if !ok {
713			logging.Warn(ctx, "configured summary provider does not support text generation, using default",

804	func calculateSessionAttributions(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, shadowRef *plumbing.Reference, sessionData *ExtractedSessionData, state *SessionState, opts ...attributionOpts) *cpkg.InitialAttribution {
805		// Calculate initial attribution using accumulated prompt attribution data.
806		// This uses user edits captured at each prompt start (before agent works),
807		// plus any user edits after the final checkpoint (shadow → head).
808		//
809		// When shadowRef is nil (agent committed mid-turn before SaveStep),
810		// HEAD is used as the shadow tree. This is correct because the agent's
811		// commit IS HEAD — there are no user edits between agent work and commit.
812		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "attribution")
813	
814		var o attributionOpts
815		if len(opts) > 0 {
816			o = opts[0]
817		}
818	
819		headTree := o.headTree
820		if headTree == nil {
821			headRef, headErr := repo.Head()
822			if headErr != nil {
823				logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD",
824					slog.String("error", headErr.Error()))
825				return nil
826			}
827	
828			headCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(headRef.Hash())
829			if commitErr != nil {
830				logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD commit",
831					slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))
832				return nil
833			}
834	
835			var treeErr error
836			headTree, treeErr = headCommit.Tree()
837			if treeErr != nil {
838				logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD tree",
839					slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()))
840				return nil
841			}
842		}
843	
844		// Get shadow tree: from pre-resolved cache, shadow branch, or HEAD (agent committed directly).
845		shadowTree := o.shadowTree
846		if shadowTree == nil {
847			if shadowRef != nil {
848				shadowCommit, shadowErr := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef.Hash())
849				if shadowErr != nil {
850					logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow commit",
851						slog.String("error", shadowErr.Error()),
852						slog.String("shadow_ref", shadowRef.Hash().String()))
853					return nil
854				}
855				var shadowTreeErr error
856				shadowTree, shadowTreeErr = shadowCommit.Tree()
857				if shadowTreeErr != nil {
858					logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow tree",
859						slog.String("error", shadowTreeErr.Error()))
860					return nil
861				}
862			} else {
863				// No shadow branch: agent committed mid-turn. Use HEAD as shadow
864				// because the agent's work is the commit itself.
865				logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: using HEAD as shadow (no shadow branch)")
866				shadowTree = headTree
867			}
868		}
869	
870		// Get base tree (state before session started)
871		var baseTree *object.Tree
872		attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit
873		if attrBase == "" {
874			attrBase = state.BaseCommit // backward compat
875		}
876		if baseCommit, baseErr := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(attrBase)); baseErr == nil {
877			if tree, baseTErr := baseCommit.Tree(); baseTErr == nil {
878				baseTree = tree
879			} else {
880				logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base tree unavailable",
881					slog.String("error", baseTErr.Error()))
882			}
883		} else {
884			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base commit unavailable",
885				slog.String("error", baseErr.Error()),
886				slog.String("attribution_base", attrBase))
887		}
888	
889		// Include PendingPromptAttribution if it was never moved to PromptAttributions.
890		// This happens when an agent commits mid-turn without calling SaveStep (e.g., Codex).
891		// PendingPromptAttribution is set during UserPromptSubmit but only moved to
892		// PromptAttributions during SaveStep. Without this, mid-turn commits have no PA
893		// data and pre-session worktree dirt cannot be identified for baseline exclusion.
894		promptAttrs := state.PromptAttributions
895		if state.PendingPromptAttribution != nil {
896			promptAttrs = append(promptAttrs, *state.PendingPromptAttribution)
897		}
898	
899		// Log accumulated prompt attributions for debugging
900		var totalUserAdded, totalUserRemoved int
901		for i, pa := range promptAttrs {
902			totalUserAdded += pa.UserLinesAdded
903			totalUserRemoved += pa.UserLinesRemoved
904			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution data",
905				slog.Int("checkpoint", pa.CheckpointNumber),
906				slog.Int("user_added", pa.UserLinesAdded),
907				slog.Int("user_removed", pa.UserLinesRemoved),
908				slog.Int("agent_added", pa.AgentLinesAdded),
909				slog.Int("agent_removed", pa.AgentLinesRemoved),
910				slog.Int("index", i))
911		}
912	
913		attribution := CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated(ctx, AttributionParams{
914			BaseTree:              baseTree,
915			ShadowTree:            shadowTree,
916			HeadTree:              headTree,
917			ParentTree:            o.parentTree,
918			FilesTouched:          sessionData.FilesTouched,
919			PromptAttributions:    promptAttrs,
920			RepoDir:               o.repoDir,
921			ParentCommitHash:      o.parentCommitHash,
922			AttributionBaseCommit: attrBase,
923			HeadCommitHash:        o.headCommitHash,
924			AllAgentFiles:         o.allAgentFiles,
925		})
926	
927		if attribution != nil {
928			logging.Info(logCtx, "attribution calculated",
929				slog.Int("agent_lines", attribution.AgentLines),
930				slog.Int("human_added", attribution.HumanAdded),
931				slog.Int("human_modified", attribution.HumanModified),
932				slog.Int("human_removed", attribution.HumanRemoved),
933				slog.Int("total_committed", attribution.TotalCommitted),
934				slog.Float64("agent_percentage", attribution.AgentPercentage),
935				slog.Int("accumulated_user_added", totalUserAdded),
936				slog.Int("accumulated_user_removed", totalUserRemoved),
937				slog.Int("files_touched", len(sessionData.FilesTouched)))
938		}
939	
940		return attribution
941	}

958	// extractSessionData extracts session data from the shadow branch.
959	// filesTouched is the list of files tracked during the session (from SessionState.FilesTouched).
960	// agentType identifies the agent (e.g., "Gemini CLI", "Claude Code") to determine transcript format.
961	// liveTranscriptPath, when non-empty and readable, is preferred over the shadow branch copy.
962	// This handles the case where SaveStep was skipped (no code changes) but the transcript
963	// continued growing — the shadow branch copy would be stale.
964	// checkpointTranscriptStart is the line offset (Claude) or message index (Gemini) where the current checkpoint began.
965	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionData(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, shadowRef plumbing.Hash, sessionID string, filesTouched []string, agentType types.AgentType, liveTranscriptPath string, checkpointTranscriptStart int, isActive bool) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
966		ag, _ := agent.GetByAgentType(agentType) //nolint:errcheck // ag may be nil for unknown agent types; callers use type assertions so nil is safe
967		commit, err := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef)
968		if err != nil {
969			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
970		}
971	
972		tree, err := commit.Tree()
973		if err != nil {
974			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
975		}
976	
977		data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
978		// sessionID is already an "entire session ID" (with date prefix)
979		metadataDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
980	
981		// Extract transcript — prefer the live file when available, fall back to shadow branch.
982		// The shadow branch copy may be stale if the last turn ended without code changes
983		// (SaveStep is only called when there are file modifications).
984		var fullTranscript string
985		if liveTranscriptPath != "" {
986			// Ensure transcript file exists (OpenCode creates it lazily via `opencode export`).
987			// Only wait for flush when the session is active — for idle/ended sessions the
988			// transcript is already fully flushed (the Stop hook completed the flush).
989			if isActive {
990				prepareTranscriptIfNeeded(ctx, ag, liveTranscriptPath)
991			}
992			if liveData, readErr := os.ReadFile(liveTranscriptPath); readErr == nil && len(liveData) > 0 { //nolint:gosec // path from session state
993				fullTranscript = string(liveData)
994			}
995		}
996		if fullTranscript == "" {
997			// Fall back to shadow branch copy
998			if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
999				if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
1000					fullTranscript = content
1001				}
1002			} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
1003				if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
1004					fullTranscript = content
1005				}
1006			}
1007		}
1008	
1009		// Process transcript based on agent type
1010		if fullTranscript != "" {
1011			data.Transcript = []byte(fullTranscript)
1012			data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(agentType, fullTranscript)
1013			// Read prompts from shadow branch tree (source of truth after SaveStep)
1014			if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.PromptFileName); fileErr == nil {
1015				if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil && content != "" {
1016					data.Prompts = splitPromptContent(content)
1017				}
1018			}
1019			// Filesystem fallback (written at turn start, covers mid-turn commits)
1020			if len(data.Prompts) == 0 {
1021				data.Prompts = readPromptsFromFilesystem(ctx, sessionID)
1022			}
1023		}
1024	
1025		// Use tracked files from session state (not all files in tree)
1026		data.FilesTouched = filesTouched
1027	
1028		// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
1029		if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
1030			data.TokenUsage = agent.CalculateTokenUsage(ctx, ag, data.Transcript, checkpointTranscriptStart, "") //TODO: why do we not use here subagents dir?
1031		}
1032	
1033		return data, nil
1034	}

1074	// countTranscriptItems counts lines (JSONL) or messages (JSON) in a transcript.
1075	// For Claude Code and JSONL-based agents, this counts lines.
1076	// For Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and JSON-based agents, this counts messages.
1077	// Returns 0 if the content is empty or malformed.
1078	func countTranscriptItems(agentType types.AgentType, content string) int {
1079		if content == "" {
1080			return 0
1081		}
1082	
1083		// OpenCode uses export JSON format with {"info": {...}, "messages": [...]}
1084		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
1085			session, err := opencode.ParseExportSession([]byte(content))
1086			if err == nil && session != nil {
1087				return len(session.Messages)
1088			}
1089			return 0
1090		}
1091	
1092		// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
1093		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
1094			transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript([]byte(content))
1095			if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
1096				return len(transcript.Messages)
1097			}
1098			// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return 0
1099			if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
1100				return 0
1101			}
1102			// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
1103		}
1104	
1105		// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
1106		allLines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
1107		// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
1108		for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
1109			allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
1110		}
1111		return len(allLines)
1112	}

1115	// Returns prompts with IDE context tags stripped (e.g., <ide_opened_file>).
1116	func extractUserPrompts(agentType types.AgentType, content string) []string {
1117		if content == "" {
1118			return nil
1119		}
1120	
1121		// Droid has its own envelope format — use its parser to normalize first
1122		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeFactoryAIDroid {
1123			lines, _, err := factoryaidroid.ParseDroidTranscriptFromBytes([]byte(content), 0)
1124			if err != nil {
1125				return nil
1126			}
1127			var prompts []string
1128			for _, line := range lines {
1129				if line.Type != transcript.TypeUser {
1130					continue
1131				}
1132				if text := transcript.ExtractUserContent(line.Message); text != "" {
1133					if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(text); stripped != "" {
1134						prompts = append(prompts, stripped)
1135					}
1136				}
1137			}
1138			return prompts
1139		}
1140	
1141		// OpenCode uses JSONL with a different per-line schema than Claude Code
1142		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
1143			prompts, err := opencode.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
1144			if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
1145				cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
1146				for _, prompt := range prompts {
1147					if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
1148						cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
1149					}
1150				}
1151				return cleaned
1152			}
1153			return nil
1154		}
1155	
1156		// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
1157		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
1158			prompts, err := geminicli.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
1159			if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
1160				// Strip IDE context tags for consistency with Claude Code handling
1161				cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
1162				for _, prompt := range prompts {
1163					if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
1164						cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
1165					}
1166				}
1167				return cleaned
1168			}
1169			// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return nil
1170			if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
1171				return nil
1172			}
1173			// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
1174		}
1175	
1176		// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
1177		return extractUserPromptsFromLines(strings.Split(content, "\n"))
1178	}

1180	// extractUserPromptsFromLines extracts user prompts from JSONL transcript lines.
1181	// IDE-injected context tags (like <ide_opened_file>) are stripped from the results.
1182	func extractUserPromptsFromLines(lines []string) []string {
1183		var prompts []string
1184		for _, line := range lines {
1185			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
1186			if line == "" {
1187				continue
1188			}
1189	
1190			var entry map[string]interface{}
1191			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry); err != nil {
1192				continue
1193			}
1194	
1195			// Check for user message:
1196			// - Claude Code uses "type": "human" or "type": "user"
1197			// - Cursor uses "role": "user"
1198			msgType, _ := entry["type"].(string) //nolint:errcheck // type assertion on interface{} from JSON
1199			msgRole, _ := entry["role"].(string) //nolint:errcheck // type assertion on interface{} from JSON
1200			isUser := msgType == "human" || msgType == "user" || msgRole == "user"
1201			if !isUser {
1202				continue
1203			}
1204	
1205			// Extract message content
1206			message, ok := entry["message"].(map[string]interface{})
1207			if !ok {
1208				continue
1209			}
1210	
1211			// Handle string content
1212			if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
1213				cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(content)
1214				if cleaned != "" {
1215					prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
1216				}
1217				continue
1218			}
1219	
1220			// Handle array content (e.g., multiple text blocks from VSCode)
1221			if arr, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
1222				var texts []string
1223				for _, item := range arr {
1224					if m, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
1225						if m["type"] == "text" {
1226							if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok {
1227								texts = append(texts, text)
1228							}
1229						}
1230					}
1231				}
1232				if len(texts) > 0 {
1233					cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(strings.Join(texts, "\n\n"))
1234					if cleaned != "" {
1235						prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
1236					}
1237				}
1238			}
1239		}
1240		return prompts
1241	}

1288	// CondenseSessionByID condenses a session by its ID and cleans up.
1289	// This is used by "entire doctor" to salvage stuck sessions.
1290	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSessionByID(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
1291		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "condense-by-id")
1292	
1293		// Load session state
1294		state, err := s.loadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
1295		if err != nil {
1296			return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
1297		}
1298		if state == nil {
1299			return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
1300		}
1301	
1302		// Open repository
1303		repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
1304		if err != nil {
1305			return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
1306		}
1307	
1308		// Generate a checkpoint ID
1309		checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
1310		if err != nil {
1311			return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
1312		}
1313	
1314		// Check if shadow branch exists (required for condensation)
1315		shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
1316		refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
1317		_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
1318		hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
1319	
1320		if !hasShadowBranch {
1321			// No shadow branch means no checkpoint data to condense.
1322			// Just clean up the state file.
1323			logging.Info(logCtx, "no shadow branch for session, clearing state only",
1324				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
1325				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
1326			)
1327			if err := s.clearSessionState(ctx, sessionID); err != nil {
1328				return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
1329			}
1330			return nil
1331		}
1332	
1333		// Condense the session
1334		result, err := s.CondenseSession(ctx, repo, checkpointID, state, nil)
1335		if err != nil {
1336			return fmt.Errorf("failed to condense session: %w", err)
1337		}
1338	
1339		if result.Skipped {
1340			// Nothing to condense. Mark fully condensed so entire doctor doesn't
1341			// keep retrying this empty session on every invocation.
1342			logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensation skipped (no transcript or files), marking fully condensed",
1343				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
1344			)
1345			state.FullyCondensed = true
1346			return s.saveSessionState(ctx, state)
1347		}
1348	
1349		logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensed by ID",
1350			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
1351			slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
1352			slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
1353		)
1354	
1355		// Update session state: reset step count and transition to idle
1356		state.StepCount = 0
1357		state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
1358		state.CompactTranscriptStart += result.CompactTranscriptLines
1359		state.CheckpointTranscriptSize = int64(len(result.Transcript))
1360		state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
1361		state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
1362		state.LastCheckpointCommitHash = state.BaseCommit
1363		state.RealignAttributionBase(state.BaseCommit)
1364		state.PromptAttributions = nil
1365		state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
1366	
1367		if err := s.saveSessionState(ctx, state); err != nil {
1368			return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
1369		}
1370	
1371		// Clean up shadow branch if no other sessions need it
1372		if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
1373			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
1374				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
1375				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
1376			)
1377			// Non-fatal: condensation succeeded, shadow branch cleanup is best-effort
1378		}
1379	
1380		return nil
1381	}

1383	// CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed condenses an ENDED session and marks it
1384	// FullyCondensed in one operation. Used by the session stop hook to eagerly
1385	// clean up sessions so PostCommit doesn't have to process them.
1386	//
1387	// This does NOT call CondenseSessionByID because that method has two behaviors
1388	// we don't want: (1) it calls clearSessionState when no shadow branch exists
1389	// (deletes the state file entirely), and (2) it sets Phase = IDLE. Instead,
1390	// we inline the condensation logic with ENDED-appropriate behavior.
1391	//
1392	// Fail-open: if condensation fails, the session is left in its current state
1393	// and PostCommit will still process it on the next commit.
1394	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
1395		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
1396	
1397		state, err := s.loadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
1398		if err != nil {
1399			return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
1400		}
1401		if state == nil {
1402			return nil // No state file
1403		}
1404	
1405		// Sessions with FilesTouched must be processed by PostCommit for carry-forward
1406		// tracking — each user commit that overlaps with tracked files gets its own
1407		// checkpoint. Eagerly condensing here would prevent that 1:1 linkage.
1408		if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 {
1409			return nil
1410		}
1411	
1412		// Only condense if there's uncondensed data
1413		if state.StepCount <= 0 {
1414			// No data and no files — mark FullyCondensed
1415			state.FullyCondensed = true
1416			return s.saveSessionState(ctx, state)
1417		}
1418	
1419		// Check if shadow branch exists — required for condensation
1420		repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
1421		if err != nil {
1422			logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to open repository",
1423				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
1424				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
1425			)
1426			return nil // fail-open
1427		}
1428	
1429		shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
1430		refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
1431		_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
1432		hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
1433	
1434		if !hasShadowBranch {
1435			// No shadow branch = no checkpoint data to condense.
1436			// Unlike CondenseSessionByID, we do NOT delete the state file.
1437			logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense: no shadow branch",
1438				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
1439				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
1440			)
1441			state.StepCount = 0
1442			state.FullyCondensed = true // FilesTouched is already empty (checked above)
1443			return s.saveSessionState(ctx, state)
1444		}
1445	
1446		// Generate checkpoint ID and condense
1447		checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
1448		if err != nil {
1449			logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to generate checkpoint ID",
1450				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
1451			)
1452			return nil // fail-open
1453		}
1454	
1455		// Condense with nil committedFiles (include all FilesTouched)
1456		result, err := s.CondenseSession(ctx, repo, checkpointID, state, nil)
1457		if err != nil {
1458			logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop failed, PostCommit will retry",
1459				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
1460				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
1461			)
1462			return nil // fail-open
1463		}
1464	
1465		if result.Skipped {
1466			// No transcript or files — nothing to condense. Mark fully condensed
1467			// so PostCommit doesn't keep retrying this empty session.
1468			logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense skipped (no transcript or files), marking fully condensed",
1469				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
1470			)
1471			state.FullyCondensed = true
1472			return s.saveSessionState(ctx, state)
1473		}
1474	
1475		// Update state — keep Phase = ENDED (unlike CondenseSessionByID which sets IDLE)
1476		state.StepCount = 0
1477		state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
1478		state.CompactTranscriptStart += result.CompactTranscriptLines
1479		state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
1480		state.LastCheckpointCommitHash = state.BaseCommit
1481		state.RealignAttributionBase(state.BaseCommit)
1482		state.PromptAttributions = nil
1483		state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
1484		state.FullyCondensed = true // FilesTouched is already empty (checked above)
1485		// Phase stays ENDED — do NOT set to IDLE
1486	
1487		logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop succeeded",
1488			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
1489			slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
1490		)
1491	
1492		if err := s.saveSessionState(ctx, state); err != nil {
1493			return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
1494		}
1495	
1496		// Clean up shadow branch
1497		if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
1498			logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to clean up shadow branch",
1499				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
1500				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
1501			)
1502		}
1503	
1504		return nil
1505	}

1507	// cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused deletes a shadow branch if no other active sessions reference it.
1508	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx context.Context, _ *git.Repository, shadowBranchName, excludeSessionID string) error {
1509		// List all session states to check if any other session uses this shadow branch
1510		allStates, err := s.listAllSessionStates(ctx)
1511		if err != nil {
1512			return fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
1513		}
1514	
1515		for _, state := range allStates {
1516			if state.SessionID == excludeSessionID {
1517				continue
1518			}
1519			otherShadow := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
1520			if otherShadow == shadowBranchName && state.StepCount > 0 {
1521				// Another session still needs this shadow branch
1522				return nil
1523			}
1524		}
1525	
1526		// No other sessions need it, delete the shadow branch via CLI
1527		// (go-git v5's RemoveReference doesn't persist with packed refs/worktrees)
1528		if err := DeleteBranchCLI(ctx, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
1529			// Branch already gone is not an error
1530			if errors.Is(err, ErrBranchNotFound) {
1531				return nil
1532			}
1533			return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove shadow branch: %w", err)
1534		}
1535		return nil
1536	}

1538	// compactTranscriptForV2 produces the Entire Transcript Format (transcript.jsonl)
1539	// from a redacted agent transcript. Returns nil if compaction cannot be performed
1540	// (nil agent, empty transcript, or compaction error) —
1541	// callers treat nil as "skip writing transcript.jsonl to /main".
1542	func compactTranscriptForV2(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, transcript redact.RedactedBytes, checkpointTranscriptStart int) []byte {
1543		if ag == nil || transcript.Len() == 0 {
1544			return nil
1545		}
1546	
1547		compacted, err := compact.Compact(transcript, compact.MetadataFields{
1548			Agent:      string(ag.Name()),
1549			CLIVersion: versioninfo.Version,
1550			StartLine:  checkpointTranscriptStart,
1551		})
1552		if err != nil {
1553			logging.Warn(ctx, "compact transcript generation failed, skipping transcript.jsonl on /main",
1554				slog.String("agent", string(ag.Name())),
1555				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
1556			)
1557			return nil
1558		}
1559		return compacted

1562	// countCompactLines returns line count for compact transcript JSONL.
1563	func countCompactLines(compactTranscript []byte) int {
1564		return bytes.Count(compactTranscript, []byte{'\n'})
1565	}

1567	// computeCompactTranscriptStart chooses the compact transcript start line offset
1568	// for v2 /main metadata.
1569	//
1570	// Preferred source is session state CompactTranscriptStart. For legacy sessions
1571	// that have only full-transcript offsets persisted, this recalculates the compact
1572	// offset from transcript bytes when possible. On any failure, returns 0 (fail-open).
1573	func computeCompactTranscriptStart(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, state *SessionState, transcript []byte, scopedCompact []byte) int {
1574		if state.CompactTranscriptStart > 0 {
1575			return state.CompactTranscriptStart
1576		}
1577		if state.CheckpointTranscriptStart == 0 || ag == nil || len(transcript) == 0 || len(scopedCompact) == 0 {
1578			return 0
1579		}
1580	
1581		// transcript is already redacted (passed as .Bytes() from RedactedBytes).
1582		fullCompacted, err := compact.Compact(redact.AlreadyRedacted(transcript), compact.MetadataFields{
1583			Agent:      string(ag.Name()),
1584			CLIVersion: versioninfo.Version,
1585			StartLine:  0,
1586		})
1587		if err != nil || len(fullCompacted) == 0 {
1588			logging.Warn(ctx, "failed to recalculate compact transcript start, using 0",
1589				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
1590			)
1591			return 0
1592		}
1593	
1594		fullLines := countCompactLines(fullCompacted)
1595		scopedLines := countCompactLines(scopedCompact)
1596		offset := fullLines - scopedLines
1597		if offset < 0 {
1598			return 0
1599		}
1600		return offset
1601	}

1705	func resolveV2SessionIndexForCheckpoint(repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, sessionID string) (int, error) {
1706		v2MainRef, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.ReferenceName(paths.V2MainRefName), true)
1707		if err != nil {
1708			return 0, fmt.Errorf("read v2 /main ref: %w", err)
1709		}
1710		v2MainCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(v2MainRef.Hash())
1711		if err != nil {
1712			return 0, fmt.Errorf("read v2 /main commit: %w", err)
1713		}
1714		v2MainTree, err := v2MainCommit.Tree()
1715		if err != nil {
1716			return 0, fmt.Errorf("read v2 /main tree: %w", err)
1717		}
1718	
1719		checkpointTree, err := v2MainTree.Tree(checkpointID.Path())
1720		if err != nil {
1721			return 0, fmt.Errorf("read checkpoint subtree on v2 /main: %w", err)
1722		}
1723	
1724		metadataFile, err := checkpointTree.File(paths.MetadataFileName)
1725		if err != nil {
1726			return 0, fmt.Errorf("read checkpoint summary metadata: %w", err)
1727		}
1728		metadataContent, err := metadataFile.Contents()
1729		if err != nil {
1730			return 0, fmt.Errorf("read checkpoint summary contents: %w", err)
1731		}
1732	
1733		var summary cpkg.CheckpointSummary
1734		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(metadataContent), &summary); err != nil {
1735			return 0, fmt.Errorf("parse checkpoint summary metadata: %w", err)
1736		}
1737	
1738		for i := range len(summary.Sessions) {
1739			sessionTree, err := checkpointTree.Tree(strconv.Itoa(i))
1740			if err != nil {
1741				continue
1742			}
1743			sessionMetadataFile, err := sessionTree.File(paths.MetadataFileName)
1744			if err != nil {
1745				continue
1746			}
1747			sessionMetadataContent, err := sessionMetadataFile.Contents()
1748			if err != nil {
1749				continue
1750			}
1751	
1752			var sessionMeta cpkg.CommittedMetadata
1753			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(sessionMetadataContent), &sessionMeta); err != nil {
1754				continue
1755			}
1756			if sessionMeta.SessionID == sessionID {
1757				return i, nil
1758			}
1759		}
1760	
1761		return 0, fmt.Errorf("session %q not found in v2 checkpoint %s", sessionID, checkpointID)
1762	}

1764	func spliceTaskTreeToV2FullCurrent(
1765		ctx context.Context,
1766		repo *git.Repository,
1767		v2Store *cpkg.V2GitStore,
1768		checkpointID id.CheckpointID,
1769		sessionIndex int,
1770		tasksTreeHash plumbing.Hash,
1771	) error {
1772		refName := plumbing.ReferenceName(paths.V2FullCurrentRefName)
1773		parentHash, rootTreeHash, err := v2Store.GetRefState(refName)
1774		if err != nil {
1775			return fmt.Errorf("get v2 /full/current ref state: %w", err)
1776		}
1777		incomingTasksTree, err := repo.TreeObject(tasksTreeHash)
1778		if err != nil {
1779			return fmt.Errorf("read task tree: %w", err)
1780		}
1781	
1782		shardPrefix := string(checkpointID[:2])
1783		shardSuffix := string(checkpointID[2:])
1784		sessionDir := strconv.Itoa(sessionIndex)
1785	
1786		newRootHash, err := cpkg.UpdateSubtree(repo, rootTreeHash,
1787			[]string{shardPrefix, shardSuffix, sessionDir, "tasks"},
1788			incomingTasksTree.Entries,
1789			cpkg.UpdateSubtreeOptions{MergeMode: cpkg.MergeKeepExisting},
1790		)
1791		if err != nil {
1792			return fmt.Errorf("splice task tree into v2 /full/current: %w", err)
1793		}
1794	
1795		authorName, authorEmail := cpkg.GetGitAuthorFromRepo(repo)
1796		commitHash, err := cpkg.CreateCommit(ctx, repo, newRootHash, parentHash,
1797			fmt.Sprintf("Checkpoint: %s (task metadata)\n", checkpointID),
1798			authorName, authorEmail)
1799		if err != nil {
1800			return fmt.Errorf("create v2 task metadata commit: %w", err)

+// CleanupV1TranscriptFiles removes legacy v1-named transcript files (full.jsonl,
+// full.jsonl.*, content_hash.txt) from /full/current for a given checkpoint.
+// Older CLI versions wrote these before the rename to raw_transcript.
+// Returns nil if /full/current doesn't exist or no v1 files were found.
+func (s *V2GitStore) CleanupV1TranscriptFiles(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, sessionCount int) error {
+	refName := plumbing.ReferenceName(paths.V2FullCurrentRefName)
+	parentHash, rootTreeHash, err := s.GetRefState(refName)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil //nolint:nilerr // /full/current doesn't exist yet — nothing to clean
+	}
+
+	checkpointPath := checkpointID.Path()
+	basePath := checkpointPath + "/"
+
+	entries, err := s.gs.flattenCheckpointEntries(rootTreeHash, checkpointPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Checkpoint not in tree — nothing to clean
+	}
+
+	changed := false
+	for sessionIdx := range sessionCount {
+		sessionPath := fmt.Sprintf("%s%d/", basePath, sessionIdx)
+		v1TranscriptPath := sessionPath + paths.TranscriptFileName
+		v1HashPath := sessionPath + paths.ContentHashFileName
+
+		for key := range entries {
+			switch {
+			case key == v1TranscriptPath,
+				strings.HasPrefix(key, v1TranscriptPath+"."),
+				key == v1HashPath:
+				delete(entries, key)
+				changed = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	if !changed {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	newTreeHash, err := s.gs.spliceCheckpointSubtree(ctx, rootTreeHash, checkpointID, basePath, entries)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("tree surgery failed: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	authorName, authorEmail := GetGitAuthorFromRepo(s.repo)
+	return s.updateRef(ctx, refName, newTreeHash, parentHash,
+		fmt.Sprintf("Clean up v1 transcript files for %s\n", checkpointID),
+		authorName, authorEmail)
+}
